## Aquaspin export
1. Create an n8n Header Auth credential with header name `x-aquaspin-export-token`.
2. Set the credential value to the same secret stored in Supabase as `N8N_EXPORT_TOKEN`.
3. Attach that credential to the Webhook node.
4. Activate the workflow and store the production webhook URL in Supabase as `N8N_EXPORT_WEBHOOK_URL`.
5. Attach a Google Sheets (OAuth2) credential to both Google Sheets nodes for the Sheets option. CSV works without Google OAuth.

The Edge Function excludes soft-deleted rows before this workflow is called. The Google Sheets response now waits until Append Rows finishes before returning the sheet link.
